# Mannan Shukla

> Personal site of Mannan Shukla. Primary project: spawnpoint — the easiest way to bring your software online, where an agent deploys a small app over MCP and gets back a public URL.

## Projects

- [spawnpoint](https://mannan.dev/spawnpoint-site/): The easiest way to bring your software online — an agent builds a small app, calls spawnpoint's MCP server to deploy it, and gets back a public URL.
- [spawnpoint — agent-readable index](https://mannan.dev/spawnpoint-site/llms.txt): Full markdown map of the spawnpoint docs (getting started, MCP server, API tokens).
